purpose: Technical mapping and compatibility matrix for the eight selected Player source identities.
offlineAcceptancePolicy: All entries remain experimental and non-recommended until native device acceptance is recorded.

sources.name: Synthetiq Movies
sources.technicalGap: The keyless StreamingUnity search, details, movie and selected-season routes are mapped with compound content ID plus title slug references. Movie routes check returned ID, slug, movie type and requested audio flag before the iframe. TV preflight selects the requested source episode row and checks title, slug, TV type, season, episode ID, episode number and requested audio flag before the iframe. The bounded definition follows only declared Vix embed/playlist URLs and reads literal streams/masterPlaylist initializers without executing page code. A live Vix master-playlist request returned HTTP 403, so mapped HLS candidates have not passed live inspection and playable audio, quality, captions, transfer and native offline acceptance remain unverified. The downstream Vix playlist ID is opaque and does not echo the StreamingUnity episode ID. Source artwork records/CDN mapping and generic catalogue facets are not mapped in this experimental definition.

sources.name: Alpha Movies
sources.technicalGap: A bounded AES-GCM helper decodes public Vidrock resolver rows. Search/details and TV season/episode-to-resolver identity are not mapped in the Downloads host, so no Alpha source definition or operational route is present.

sources.name: Synthetiq Anime

capabilities.serverResolve: 12 bounded alternatives including exact Wave EchoVideo fallback; live reported Ramparts E1 SUB resolves

sources.technicalGap: Compared fresh published Player Anime 1.0.5-beta.2 (verified archive hash); the previously cited development 1.0.6-beta.1 was not located in registered local worktrees in this pass. Added bounded Wave EchoVideo embed-1 path extraction, descriptor and HLS mapping. Direct opaque source tokens are rejected. Live exact Ramparts of Ice Season 2 E1 SUB resolution and 155-segment HLS inspection pass. Primary Flow/Zuri still return HTTP 502. Black Clover E1 SUB complete paced workstation transfer passed 325/325 segments with H.264/AAC and matching duration; unrestricted transfer hit HTTP 429 and is explicitly a failure. This is not native-phone acceptance. Optional captions depend on actual returned tracks; no external tracks were returned for these checked routes. EchoVideo embed-20 direct-file and packed players remain unsupported. Complete native phone transfer, background/return, caption selection and repeated offline playback remain unverified.

sources.name: AniPM
sources.technicalGap: Fixtures verify title identity, numbered episode, requested Sub/Dub availability, effective audio, returned backup identity, and the declared MegaPlay URL origin/path/audio before following it. The provider numeric path segment remains opaque and is not independently bound to the episode ID. Coordinator live inspection reached the HLS playlist for both Sub and Dub (321 segments, 1,477.974 seconds; seven requests each, six HTTP 200 and one HTTP 206), with zero caption tracks and no media transfer. Physical-device/offline acceptance remains pending.
